_note: Copied to .mcu-profile.json by /scaffold-mcu-project arm <part>. Full key reference: `mcu --schema`. Edit chip/core/fpu/floatAbi/flashTool and the sizeBudget for your specific part, then run `svd-find --set <part>` and `mcu --export`.

_flashTool_guidance.openocd: STM32 F0/F1/F2/F3/F4/F7, G0/G4, L0/L1/L4, WB55, WL; RP2040; MSPM0. Supported by OpenOCD 0.12.0.
_flashTool_guidance.probe-rs: REQUIRED for STM32WBA5x/WBA6x (incl. WBA65), U5, H5, C0, N6. OpenOCD 0.12 does not know these parts and fails with 'auto_probe failed' / 'Failed to read memory'. probe-rs also applies the ARMv8-M debug sequence, which OpenOCD's stm32wbax.cfg does not.
_flashTool_guidance.pyocd: Anything brand new. `pyocd pack install <part>` pulls device support AND the SVD from ST's CMSIS-Pack.
_flashTool_guidance.cubeprog: ST's own STM32_Programmer_CLI, from a host-mounted STM32CubeCLT. Day-one support for every part; needs an ST account to download, so it is not baked into the image.

stm32wb55._note: Dual-core: the BLE stack runs on a separate Cortex-M0+ network core with ST's pre-flashed firmware.

stm32l5._note: TrustZone. Check option bytes before flashing — /stm32-option-bytes.

stm32wba5x._note: OpenOCD 0.12 lacks WBA flash support (added upstream after the release).

stm32wba65._note: 2 MB flash in two 1 MB banks @0x08000000, 448 KB SRAM + 64 KB SRAM2. OpenOCD does NOT support this part at all. Single-core: the BLE controller runs on this same M33 as ST binary libraries.

hostTest: cmake -S . -B build-host -G Ninja -DHOST_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build-host && ctest --test-dir build-host --output-on-failure
flash: openocd -f ${OPENOCD_INTERFACE:-interface/stlink.cfg} -f ${OPENOCD_TARGET:?set OPENOCD_TARGET in .mcu-profile.json} -c 'program ${ELF:-build/firmware.elf} verify reset exit'
erase: openocd -f ${OPENOCD_INTERFACE:-interface/stlink.cfg} -f ${OPENOCD_TARGET:?set OPENOCD_TARGET in .mcu-profile.json} -c 'init; reset halt; flash erase_sector 0 0 last; exit'
reset: openocd -f ${OPENOCD_INTERFACE:-interface/stlink.cfg} -f ${OPENOCD_TARGET:?set OPENOCD_TARGET in .mcu-profile.json} -c 'init; reset run; exit'

_probe_rs_variant._note: Swap these in when flashTool is probe-rs (STM32WBA65, U5, H5, L5, C0, N6). probe-rs works over ST-Link v2/v3 and CMSIS-DAP, so existing probes are fine.

_cubeprog_variant._note: Requires a host-mounted STM32CubeCLT: -v ~/st/STM32CubeCLT:/opt/st/clt:ro. Use ST's programmer and GDB server, NOT the OpenOCD in that bundle — ST's fork was also reported missing WBA65 support.
